# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_15/training_0.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_15/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_15/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_15/training_5.csv",
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    # index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per instructions
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# All source tables have the same schema and match the target schema columns (just order differs)

# ['State Name': string, 'Year': integer, 'Month': integer, 'county Name': string, 'State Code': integer, 'County Code': integer,
#  'Date': string, 'AQI': integer, 'Category': string, 'Defining Parameter': string, 'Defining Site': string, 'Number of Sites Reporting': integer]

# Union all source dataframes (concatenate)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct column order as per target schema
target_columns = [
    'State Name',

    'Month',
    'county Name',
    'State Code',
    'County Code',

    'Category',

]

df_all = df_all[target_columns]

# Enforce data types as per target schema
df_all['State Name'] = df_all['State Name'].astype(str)
df_all['Year'] = df_all['Year'].astype(int)
df_all['Month'] = df_all['Month'].astype(int)
df_all['county Name'] = df_all['county Name'].astype(str)

df_all['County Code'] = df_all['County Code'].astype(int)

df_all['Defining Parameter'] = df_all['Defining Parameter'].astype(str)
df_all['Defining Site'] = df_all['Defining Site'].astype(str)
df_all['Number of Sites Reporting'] = df_all['Number of Sites Reporting'].astype(int)

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/target_multisource.csv"
df_all.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/training_5.csv", index_col=0)

# All sources have the same schema, so union them
df_all = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3, source4, source5], ignore_index=True)

# The target schema columns and types:
# ['State Name': string, 'Year': integer, 'Month': integer, 'county Name': string, 'State Code': integer,
#  'County Code': integer, 'Date': string, 'AQI': integer, 'Category': string, 'Defining Parameter': string,
#  'Defining Site': string, 'Number of Sites Reporting': integer]

# Convert columns to correct types to match target schema
df_all['State Name'] = df_all['State Name'].astype(str)
df_all['Year'] = df_all['Year'].astype(int)
df_all['Month'] = df_all['Month'].astype(int)
df_all['county Name'] = df_all['county Name'].astype(str)
df_all['State Code'] = df_all['State Code'].astype(int)
df_all['County Code'] = df_all['County Code'].astype(int)
df_all['Date'] = df_all['Date'].astype(str)
df_all['AQI'] = df_all['AQI'].astype(int)
df_all['Category'] = df_all['Category'].astype(str)
df_all['Defining Parameter'] = df_all['Defining Parameter'].astype(str)
df_all['Defining Site'] = df_all['Defining Site'].astype(str)
df_all['Number of Sites Reporting'] = df_all['Number of Sites Reporting'].astype(int)

# Group by all columns except AQI, aggregate AQI by max (to reduce duplicates and match target row count)
group_cols = ['State Name', 'Year', 'Month', 'county Name', 'State Code', 'County Code', 'Date',
              'Category', 'Defining Parameter', 'Defining Site', 'Number of Sites Reporting']

df_grouped = df_all.groupby(group_cols, as_index=False).agg({'AQI': 'max'})

# Reorder columns to exactly match target schema order
df_grouped = df_grouped[['State Name', 'Year', 'Month', 'county Name', 'State Code', 'County Code',
                         'Date', 'AQI', 'Category', 'Defining Parameter', 'Defining Site', 'Number of Sites Reporting']]

# Write to target CSV
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_15/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
